purpose: Test the actual explicit-state + learned query scorer + exact executor repair at 32B on the retained 128 cases, not native failure recurrence.

training.order: Original seed0_ORDER.json and seed1_ORDER.json sample-order lists
training.fallback_rule: Choose only from canary memory/throughput before protected inference; same for both seeds
training.loss: response-only Yes/No + EOS cross entropy; input and padding masked

scoring.candidate_mode: RAW original PPR/QSA1 contract, not READBACK or type filtering

endpoints.old_7B_results: separate historical context only, no reused adapters or fresh 7B run

evaluation.primary_unit: complete post subject: every target AND every control correct across all four histories, full 128 denominator
evaluation.primary_codec: unchanged PPR whole-response source-ID/name codec for saved and new answer-only outputs; native9 labels stay under original SCALE rule
evaluation.first_line_sensitivity: retain old SCALE first-line interpretation separately; never pick the favorable parser

bootstrap.unit: subject; all questions/histories and both seeds together

evaluation.known_9_requirement: correct target plus faithful intended program across histories, both references, and every retained control for its case correct; no requalification
evaluation.repeat_scope: every current question under all six source conditions, separate process, no result cache; STATE_BASE and both trained scorers
evaluation.isolation: complete current input equality + independent uncached control agreement; never inferred from low witness count

limits.alternative: Runpod Secure H100 SXM 80GB only after memory and full-throughput canary fits

claim_boundaries: Actual repair application at32B, not a renewed native-failure study
Current-state history independence is distinct from correct English interpretation
Same exposed128case cohort; not fresh cases or new model family
Exact target and K training-string overlap zero; 33 F/decoy occurrences shared with training remain labelled
Native error baseline is saved prior inference under its own wrapper; no claim of equal FLOPs or pure data-structure effect
No original native-editor F1-F4 pass; method breadth only
No general raw-prose ingestion; exact source-template transport is retained
